reasoning: BSP1(outline 11.2)規定品牌頁的 widget 一律成對且為 50/50 尺寸。可觀察形式是:品牌頁上恰好兩個 widget、各佔一半、無 25% 尺寸。ER 必須同時陳述數量與尺寸,只寫「顯示兩個 widget」無法排除 50/25/25 這種同樣是兩欄但尺寸不符的版面。p.19 的 SRT 與 TRX 圖例(Timers + SRT Gauges、Pitch/Roll + Performance Gauges)即為此規則的呈現。規格只規範既有版面,未言明使用者能否在品牌頁上改成其他尺寸,故不加入編輯步驟——那會斷言規格未主張的行為。單一驗證標的,不拆。優先級:屬品牌頁的版面基本約束,失效即版面錯誤,訂 P1。

tcs.test_item:
BSP1.) Widgets shall be in pairs of 50/50 sizes only.

(Brand specific page displayed -> it carries exactly two widgets, each occupying 50% of the page)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle speed is 0
2. The vehicle is equipped with a brand specific Default Page
3. The brand specific page is present on the Home Screen
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Navigate to the brand specific Home Screen page
2. Read the number of widgets displayed on the page
3. Read the size of each widget displayed on the page
tcs.expected_result:
1. The brand specific Home Screen page is displayed
2. Exactly two widgets are displayed on the page
3. Each of the two widgets occupies 50% of the page and no 25% widget is displayed
